new_observable: Probability that an unlabeled query appearance mode reaches a pure-FG reference anchor before a pure-BG reference anchor through the entire query-feature graph, relative to direct anchor-kernel evidence.
identity_hypothesis: A correctly class-connected query manifold can provide distal class evidence even when the focal query feature is equally close to reference FG/BG and every immediate neighbor has neutral direct evidence.

difference_from_existing.MEAN_and_Huber: No base fidelity in the auxiliary graph solve; reference FG/BG anchors are absorbing endpoints, not a prior query guide. Only its residual relative to direct reference evidence corrects base.
difference_from_existing.Pro_M2: No learned FF/FB/BF/BB pair-label cross-ratio, signed interaction, or transfer of a reference pair-potential. The graph is the observed unlabeled query appearance geometry with labeled reference endpoints.
difference_from_existing.old_reference_distributions: No required mode occupancy, covariance, silhouette or prevalence for query foreground; query graph connects all appearances without assigning a global reference distribution.
difference_from_existing.hull_and_quadratic: Neither pointwise distance to reference hulls nor an anchor polynomial kernel. The fixed focal query can change output when other unlabeled query appearances change.
difference_from_existing.triplet: No third-order reference interaction or matching of three appearance modes.

steps: Normalize features; require at least 8 pure FG and BG reference tokens (coverage>=0.9 and <=0.1). Otherwise retain base.

Deterministically compress each reference class to <=16 spherical modes using 5 Lloyd steps. Compress all unlabeled query tokens to <=64 spherical modes using 3 steps. Preserve hard nearest-mode query assignment.

On <=96 nodes form a mutual-8-neighbor cosine-distance graph. Edge weight is exp(-d_ij/sqrt(sigma_i*sigma_j)), with sigma_i=max(8th-neighbor distance,1e-6). No label or base value chooses graph edges.
Set every reference FG anchor to 1 and BG anchor to 0. For each component containing both classes solve L_UU*h_U = W_UB*label_B in FP64. A component missing either class abstains.
For each query mode compute class-balanced direct reference-kernel value d: mass-weighted exp(cosine/0.07) FG evidence divided by FG+BG evidence.
For active token i with query-mode assignment a_i output field_i = base_i + h[a_i] - d[a_i]. Abstained token keeps its exact base. Do not clamp or rescale final field.
Bilinear64-to1024 align_corners=False, strict >0.5; seal complete masks before query GT evaluation. All controls use the same query compression and readout.

strong_simple_controls.nearest_control: 0.5+0.5*(max FG cosine-max BG cosine), clipped; direct complete classifier on same query modes.
strong_simple_controls.kernel_control: Direct class-balanced kernel d, complete classifier on same modes.
strong_simple_controls.one_hop_control: base + reference-neighbor fraction - d; no query-query transmission, .5 for no anchor neighbors.
strong_simple_controls.one_step_control: base + one weighted graph averaging step initialized with d and fixed reference labels - d. Strong cheap same-graph local-transmission control.
strong_simple_controls.component_control: base + fraction of FG anchors in the connected component - d; reachability without conductance/path lengths.
strong_simple_controls.full_harmonic_control: Pure h complete classifier, to expose the risk of replacing MEAN globally.

control_support: All returned controls use the same full-graph active-token map; abstained tokens retain base. Thus gain over them is not attributable to changing the abstention footprint.
mathematical: On a finite connected component with a boundary the Dirichlet matrix is positive definite; solve is unique. Requiring both boundary classes is an explicit conservative abstention rule, not a uniqueness requirement.
Harmonic values lie in [0,1] and equal the random-walk probability of hitting FG before BG under these fixed graph boundary labels. Semantic probability calibration is unverified.
Each active correction h-d lies in [-1,1]; if h=d, final field equals base exactly. Missing both-class graph support preserves base.

finite_evidence.independent_solver: Six-node path analytic h=[1,.8,.6,.4,.2,0] agrees with independently iterated absorbing Markov transitions.
finite_evidence.context_witness: Complete default algorithm on a neutral stem: fixed focal q and reference anchors give .7105316 versus .2894684 after reflecting the distant branch; nearest/kernel/one-hop/one-step/component controls all .5 there.
finite_evidence.weaker_first_witness_retained: The first asymmetric arc example is also distinguished by one-step (.7077924/.2922076); it does not prove multistep necessity.
finite_evidence.negative: Declare the same 64 focal tokens background in the foreground-connected context: the unchanged algorithm adds all 64 false foreground tokens. Incorrect class bridges can reverse the apparent benefit.

failure_conditions: Semantically different appearances can form a feature bridge; hitting a foreground anchor does not guarantee the target class.
64-mode compression can merge a tiny real target or fragment its path; anchors compress label-discriminative details.
Reference context-dependent feature anchors may attach to the wrong query manifold.
No component with both anchor classes can lead to extensive abstention; actual frequency is unmeasured.
Adding a graph-context residual can still damage correct base predictions; no success or protected high-confidence guarantee is asserted.
measured_reason_for_residual: The newly observed reused-public600 v2 report has MEAN62.9315 versus covariance12.3432, prior_shift37.8833 and quadratic51.6070. Those other algorithms' failures do not refute absorption, but motivate keeping MEAN and separately reporting pure h rather than promising a global reference classifier.
source_of_existing_measurement: ../server_prepared_01a1100b/nine_public600_v2/score/report.json; reused development data, not independent confirmation

cpu_cost.compression: O(Nr*32*D*5 + Nq*64*D*3), plus deterministic farthest-point initialization and feature normalization; no NxN query affinity.
cpu_cost.graph: O(96^2*D) cosine work and O(96^2) storage; solve unknown blocks of <=64 modes.
cpu_cost.synthetic_candidate_seconds: check.json holds one 4096x1024 synthetic call; excludes real cache/image I/O and scoring.

novelty: Unverified. Absorbing random walks, harmonic label propagation and spherical compression are established ideas; this is one distinct candidate mechanism for the current cached task, not a claim of original graph mathematics.
